title: Can Dogs Eat Chocolate: Mild Signs Can Start at 9 mg Per Pound 🍫 (Things Living In Your House)
description:
Can dogs eat chocolate? This video answers our own pinned question: what would you do if your dog got to the tin? It is not a quote from a viewer, and it does not invent a commenter. The FDA says chocolate is toxic to dogs, and that theobromine is the main culprit. Theobromine can cause mild signs in dogs with doses as low as 9 mg per pound of body weight, and severe signs starting around 18 mg per pound. That dose is per pound of the dog's body weight, so the same amount can be milder for a large dog and severe for a small one. No page we checked calls any amount safe. The same FDA table lists about 57 mg of theobromine in an ounce of milk chocolate, and about 227 mg in dark chocolate with 70-85% cacao. The ASPCA says white chocolate has almost no theobromine, but sugar and fat may still lead to pancreatitis; do not call white chocolate safe. The ASPCA also says cats are sensitive to theobromine just like dogs, though they tend not to be drawn to chocolate. If your pet is sick or has a veterinary emergency, call your veterinarian. If your veterinarian is unavailable, call your local emergency animal hospital or an animal poison control center.

#dogchocolate #candogseatchocolate #theobromine #dogsafety #pethealth

Sources: FDA, Leave Chocolate Out of Rover's Celebrations, https://www.fda.gov/animal-veterinary/animal-health-literacy/leave-chocolate-out-rovers-celebrations ; ASPCA, What to Do If Your Pet Gets into Chocolate, https://www.aspca.org/news/what-do-if-your-pet-gets-chocolate ; ASPCA, People Foods to Avoid Feeding Your Pets, https://www.aspca.org/pet-care/aspca-poison-control/people-foods-avoid-feeding-your-pets ; Merck Veterinary Manual, Chocolate Toxicosis in Animals, https://www.merckvetmanual.com/toxicology/food-hazards/chocolate-toxicosis-in-animals ; UC Davis, Chocolate Poisoning in Dogs, https://healthtopics.vetmed.ucdavis.edu/health-topics/chocolate-poisoning-dogs ; AVMA, Household Hazards brochure (2022).
